firstPortCandidate.operation: scripts/reference/self-model.ts::loadSelfModel (authored identity + source/model manifest admission + predecessor graph validation)
firstPortCandidate.firstRustCLI: `umf reference self-model-check --stdin-wire` accepts the exact source UTF-8 string and manifest value over private wire transport. The Rust API computes the source SHA-256, calls parse_model only, checks authored identity before profile/source/model hashes, validates the predecessor Record/Field graph, and returns the unchanged catalog shape. It does not call compile_model; compilerSha256 is copied from provenance, not independently attested. Bun retains filesystem reads and staging.
firstPortCandidate.currentRustOwner: umf-metamodel owns the new bounded self-model admission and graph projection APIs; CLI transport is added. No Bun consumer is activated. Graph parity, first-refusal coverage, resource controls, Rust compile/test evidence and final metamodel fixed-point verification remain gates. The current admitted profile explicitly refuses non-string module/element IDs, record definitions and declared reference targets.
firstPortCandidate.parityGate: Frozen bytes and canonical predecessor catalog/graph are in r7-self-model-admission/frozen. Compare recursively lexicographically canonicalized catalog and graph (not JCS); accept matching source and model SHA; preserve exact supported error order/text; cover unresolved members, duplicate edges, definition collisions, shape traversal, false labels, ECMAScript scalar/object/array ToString controls, malformed containers, UTF16 and numeric-key diagnostics, and late control/resource cases. The focused Rust metamodel reference suite passed 18 tests; the CLI parity test passed with and without default features, and an installed CLI replay passed with its child PATH empty. Eight Bun predecessor tests passed (38 assertions). Rust applies bounded ECMAScript ToString to the JSON value domain. The generated-output fixed point passes for the refreshed source cohort. Broader refusal/resource parity, independent R7 review, consumer parity and default activation remain open.
firstPortCandidate.consumerActivation: Not activated. Keep the Bun reference consumer until frozen catalog and graph parity plus refusal/resource gates pass; then switch that consumer explicitly. CLI evidence alone does not activate browser or reader consumers.

limitations: This is an inventory, not a Rust port or R7 completion claim.
Only the 31 R4-enumerated root files and named first-port gate files are source-hashed; transitive imports are listed for roots but not recursively closed.
R4 census activation is a captured bounded traversal; this map preserves it and does not imply a fresh repository-wide retirement census.
R3 manifest membership is not treated as proof of semantic ownership or consumer activation.

liveBoundaryValidation.activationReconciliation: The 31 named R4 roots are all present at their current paths and root/import hashes are checked here; current activation statements are bound to package.json and the current consumer/build roots.
